name: Cube Rasterization via SSBO
definition: A voxel rendering technique that rasterizes 3 faces of each cube per voxel. It uses a single large index buffer (18 indices per instance) and a large SSBO containing voxel data (1 uvec2 per voxel).
summary: Cube Rasterization via SSBO renders voxels as explicit cube instances using a single draw call, distinguishing itself by providing exact geometry and explicit face culling rather than point sprites or ray-marched quads.
